description: This file defines the utility class TemporalExpressionWorker for handling persistence and retrieval of TemporalExpression objects within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for loading expressions from the database, creating expression instances based on type, and managing hierarchical relationships between expressions.

classes.name: TemporalExpressionWorker
classes.description: Utility class for handling persistence and retrieval of TemporalExpression objects within OFBiz. Contains methods for fetching, creating, and managing hierarchical relationships of temporal expressions.

methods.name: getTemporalExpression
methods.description: Retrieves a TemporalExpression object from persistent storage by its ID, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: makeTemporalExpression
methods.description: Constructs a TemporalExpression object based on the given database record, handling different types and hierarchy, including recursive calls for nested expressions.

methods.name: getExpressionTypeList
methods.description: Returns a clone of the list of all supported temporal expression types.
